item.title: Iran’s security chief: Basij force is a major national asset
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council (SNSC) Major General Mohsen Rezaei has described Iran’s Basij force as a major national asset, saying its roots in the country’s history, culture, faith and public participation give it a distinction few nations possess.

item.title: Iran’s Italy embassy warns against efforts to draw Europe into regional crisis following Kuwait attack
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s embassy in Rome has rejected allegations that Iran was responsible for a drone attack on a military facility in Kuwait that killed two Italian nationals, warning against attempts to widen the regional conflict and draw Europe into it.

item.title: Iran ready for joint probe into Kuwait attack: Araghchi
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has firmly rejected allegations that Iran was involved in a drone attack in Kuwait and expressed Tehran’s readiness to conduct a joint investigation with Kuwait and Italy to establish the facts.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86333676/Iran-ready-for-joint-probe-into-Kuwait-attack-Araghchi

Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has firmly rejected allegations that Iran was involved in a drone attack in Kuwait and expressed Tehran’s readiness to conduct a joint investigation with Kuwait and Italy to establish the facts.

item.title: Leader: Basij Organization must undergo a transformation, rebirth
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei has called for the necessity of the Basij Organization to undergo a transformation and experience rebirth, likening the self-sacrificing spirit of the Iranian nation during the recent US-Israeli-imposed war to the Basij volunteer forces.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86333294/Leader-Basij-Organization-must-undergo-a-transformation-rebirth

Tehran, IRNA — Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei has called for the necessity of the Basij Organization to undergo a transformation and experience rebirth, likening the self-sacrificing spirit of the Iranian nation during the recent US-Israeli-imposed war to the Basij volunteer forces.
